'''Shakka''' was a [[Twi'lek]] who was [[Slavery|enslaved]] to the [[Anx]] [[enslaver]] [[Graxol Kelvyyn]]. She had [[Color|red]] skin, making her a [[Lethan]] Twi'lek,<ref name="Encounters" /> and she wore a silver headpiece, as well as a silver-colored [[Clothing|bikini]] made of chains. Shakka also wore a black, spiked collar around her neck with four chains extending off of it, as well as black, spiked rings worn around her upper [[Limb|arms]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|I}}</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], Shakka accompanied Kelvyyn to watch the [[Boonta Eve Classic]], where she sat on the floor beside the Anx within a private [[Watto's box|viewing box]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shakka first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="FilmRelease">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The scenes Shakka was present in were filmed at [[Leavesden Studios]],<ref name="FilmLocation">{{InsiderCite|39|When Artoo Met Wicket}}</ref> outside of [[Wikipedia:London|London]].<ref name="London">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/bts/production/news19970929.html|text=First Phase Of Episode I Production Wraps At Leavesden Studios}}</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind" published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]].<ref name="Encounters" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity she was first pictured on the "Intergalactic Spectators" card from the first series of [[1999 Topps Star Wars: Episode I Widevision Series 1|Star Wars: Episode I Widevision]],<ref name="Intergalactic">{{Topps|set=1999 Topps Star Wars: Episode I Widevision Series 1|cardname=47 - Intergalactic Spectators|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73014/cid/5263457/1999-Topps-Widevision-Star-Wars:-Episode-I-47-Intergalactic-Spectators}}</ref> released prior to the film's debut by the collectable company [[Topps]] on [[May 3]], 1999.<ref name="Collector">{{CollectorCite|6|Around the Galaxy}}</ref> The name also originated from the Legends continuity, in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|''Star Wars: Episode I'']] action figure line, in the "Watto's Box" Cinema Scenes set<ref name="LegendsName">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|packtype=Cinema Scenes|pack=Watto's Box|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/episodeicswattosbox.asp}}</ref> also released in 1999,<ref name="SW:TUAFC">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]''</ref> which revealed the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] name to be [[Shakka/Legends|Shakka]].<ref name="LegendsName" />
